title: A crisis in 1991 opened India's economy
sources: NCERT Class 11, Indian Economic Development, ch. 3

quiz.why: Right. A balance of payments crisis.

What followed changed the economy for good.

lines.say: Foreign exchange reserves fell to just a few weeks of imports.
India pledged gold abroad to borrow.
